title: SMC/ICT trade journal record, version 1
description: One closed trade appended as one JSON line to a trade journal. Timestamps are broker-local wall-clock times, without a UTC suffix or offset. Unknown properties are permitted for additive version 1 extensions. The `default` annotations document producer defaults only; a consumer must not use them to repair an incomplete record. Semantic invariants that JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by the analyzer, not here: finite numbers, close_time >= open_time, entry_price > 0, and net_profit == gross_profit + commission + swap within one cent.

variant.description: Ablation label identifying which strategy layers were active, e.g. "full" or "no-trigger".

config_hash.description: Digest of the EA parameter set that produced this trade, so a saved report can be traced back to its inputs.

sl.description: Stop loss price. 0 means no stop was set; it is not interchangeable with an absent field.

tp.description: Take profit price. 0 means no target was set.

net_profit.description: gross_profit + commission + swap as reported by the terminal.

intended_risk_pct.description: Risk the EA asked for, e.g. SmcConfig InpRiskPercent.

realized_risk_pct.description: Actual outcome as a percentage of balance_at_open. Convention: for a losing trade it is (-net_profit / balance_at_open) * 100; for a winning or break-even trade it is 0.0, because no capital was lost and a positive figure would not describe risk. The gap against intended_risk_pct is what exposes lot-step granularity limits, and only losing trades carry that information.

mfe.description: Maximum favourable excursion in price units, measured from entry_price over the bars the position was open. Non-negative by definition. null when the excursion could not be computed, for example because bar history was unavailable; 0.0 is a real measurement meaning price never moved favourably, and the two must not be interchanged.

mae.description: Maximum adverse excursion in price units, measured from entry_price. Non-positive by definition, so a stop at distance d is breached when mae <= -d. null when the excursion could not be computed; 0.0 means price never moved adversely.

zone_percent.description: CSmcPremiumDiscount::GetZonePercent() at entry: 0 = swing low, 50 = equilibrium, 100 = swing high. null when the producing EA does not evaluate premium/discount at all; 0 is a real measurement meaning price sat at the swing low, so writing 0 for 'not computed' would assert something false.

in_ote.description: CSmcOptimalTradeEntry::IsInOTEZone() at entry. null when the producing EA does not evaluate the OTE zone; false means it was evaluated and price was outside it.

zone_types.description: Pipe-delimited overlapping zone types at entry, e.g. "OB|BPR|IFVG". "none" when zones were evaluated and none qualified, "unknown" when the producing EA does not evaluate zones at all; the two mean different things. Never an empty string.

session.description: Broker-local session label at entry, produced by CSmcTradeJournal::SessionToken. Labels are not time-zone conversions. Note that CSmcKillZone::GetSessionName returns human-readable names ("New York", "LDN-NY Overlap", "None") that this enum deliberately does not accept.
